allowed_scientific_wording: Extracted from pinned adult female FlyWire anatomy.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Each contact is a measured physiological synapse.
Root IDs identify the recorded flies.
entries.scope: one adult female FAFB specimen, v783
entries.statement: Pinned aggregate contacts and annotation identities constrain anatomy, not efficacy.

allowed_scientific_wording: Type-level correspondence, with explicit ambiguity.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Hemibrain, physiological driver and FlyWire root are interchangeable.
entries.statement: Type aliases support population correspondence; individual physiology and driver membership are not root-resolved.

allowed_scientific_wording: Sparse nonlinear integration is experimentally supported.
prohibited_scientific_wording: All cues activate exactly 5% of KCs.
PN gain 3 is physiological.
entries.statement: Coactive claws, thresholded integration and sparse responses are supported; contacts are not claws.

allowed_scientific_wording: Cholinergic transmission is supported in tested targets.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Every cholinergic contact has identical positive conductance.
entries.statement: KC cholinergic transmission and target nicotinic receptor requirements are supported at class level.

allowed_scientific_wording: APL inhibitory effects are spatially heterogeneous.
prohibited_scientific_wording: A calcium mixing coefficient measures inhibitory conductance.
entries.statement: APL activation inhibits KC responses with spatially heterogeneous effects.

allowed_scientific_wording: Local APL response representation is supported for the audited spatial assays.
prohibited_scientific_wording: All fly neurons require compartments.
A nonzero APL coupling constant was identified.
entries.statement: Local response representations outperform a shared scalar with fixed linear observation gains; this does not identify multiple voltages.

allowed_scientific_wording: Coupling magnitude remains unidentified; assay-specific zero-transfer controls are not anatomical absence.
prohibited_scientific_wording: APL compartments are biologically disconnected.
q is a conductance.
entries.statement: Locality does not identify nonzero coupling. Shared q interval includes zero; zero transfer is not universal across assays.

allowed_scientific_wording: Heterogeneous state ownership is a schema proposal.
prohibited_scientific_wording: A unified physiological kernel has been validated.
entries.statement: One root owns one biological identity and may own justified local states; choose representation by cell type and observable.

allowed_scientific_wording: Separate electrical, release, receptor and observation states when justified.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Transmitter names determine all effective signs.
entries.statement: Target/receptor-aware effects are needed where measured; a complete root-specific receptor map is unknown.

allowed_scientific_wording: Some subtype-specific biophysical components are constrained.
prohibited_scientific_wording: R3 is superior for every neuron.
MBON14 tau applies to MBON16/17.
entries.scope: specific KC subtype and MBON14 assays
entries.statement: Measured channels/temporal scales constrain components, not a held-out validated common conductance kernel.

allowed_scientific_wording: The supplemental workbook is excluded from clean validation pending authoritative resolution.
prohibited_scientific_wording: The supplementary cells independently validate the temporal model.
Duplication is conclusively proven.
entries.statement: Unresolved cell provenance/duplication and raw mean 16.9825 ms versus reported 14.48 ms exclude clean held-out validation.

allowed_scientific_wording: Compartment-specific modulation is supported; exposure mapping remains unknown.
prohibited_scientific_wording: DAN contact counts equal receptor occupancy.
Dopamine always causes LTD.
entries.statement: Compartment and timing specificity support local modulatory action. DAN electrical activity, exposure and eligibility are distinct.

allowed_scientific_wording: The endpoint identifies integrated depression, not a unique learning rate.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Eta 0.08 or the 0.1 floor is experimentally calibrated.
This numerically calibrates appetitive alpha1.
entries.statement: Charge-transfer depression 90 ± 3.7% SEM, n=5, constrains an integrated endpoint under the published protocol.

allowed_scientific_wording: Stage 1 validates narrow associative learning within its computational model.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Stage 1 validates a physiological fly brain or general intelligence.
Exact PN topology is uniquely necessary.
entries.scope: frozen Stage-1 appetitive computational experiment only
entries.statement: Real extracted anatomy, prescribed local dopamine-dependent LTD and experience produce persistent selective response change.

allowed_scientific_wording: The biological candidate has response-level and receptor evidence.
prohibited_scientific_wording: The Stage-2 effect establishes semantic novelty.
Recovery tau is known to be 1800 s.
entries.statement: Repeated odors suppress responses with recovery; postsynaptic nicotinic mechanisms contribute. This is not a universal exponential rule.

allowed_scientific_wording: A tiny model effect is not validated familiarity behavior.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Genesis recognizes novelty.
entries.statement: Persistent stimulus-specific change exists but is far below preregistered thresholds and sensitive to assumptions.

allowed_scientific_wording: Published assays support state-dependent modulation.
prohibited_scientific_wording: A scalar resource variable reproduces starvation physiology.
entries.statement: State-dependent PPL101 and MBON expression is supported in specific preparations, not a numerical resource-to-neuron function.

allowed_scientific_wording: A small modeled causal modulation exists.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Persistence, disengagement or voluntary abstention was demonstrated.
entries.statement: Selective anatomy-dependent modulation and local experience effects are orders below behavioral thresholds.

allowed_scientific_wording: VPM4 suppressive influence is supported in this assay.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Octopamine is universally inhibitory.
oa_gain=1 is a measured strength.
entries.statement: VPM4 activation suppresses MBON11 response in the tested preparation; exact receptor/dose/kinetics and every root-pair effect are unresolved.

allowed_scientific_wording: These omitted physiological mechanisms remain unresolved.
prohibited_scientific_wording: No chemical edge means no peptide or volume transmission.
entries.statement: Peptide, NO and endocrine mechanisms matter; their release/receptor maps and kinetics are not encoded by chemical contact counts.

allowed_scientific_wording: The positive-sign implementation is a historical model assumption.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Direct excitatory sign is experimentally established.
entries.scope: MBON07 to PAM11 effective net transmission
entries.statement: Anatomy and NMDA requirement motivate feedback, but do not identify direct net excitation or its strength.

allowed_scientific_wording: Normalization uncertainty can exceed anatomical expansion effects.
prohibited_scientific_wording: The denominator with the strongest behavior is biologically correct.
entries.statement: Retained-role and total-proofread-input denominators are alternative numerical choices. Biological normalization does not identify either.

allowed_scientific_wording: Identity deduplication does not reconcile physiology.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Adding stage scores creates an integrated biological brain.
entries.statement: Canonical anatomy is shared; dopamine projection, normalization, acute gates, gains and plasticity rules conflict.

allowed_scientific_wording: Architecture selection remains unresolved.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Larger neuron count establishes richer behavior.
entries.statement: Boundary closure and representation studies do not select a defensible common neural substrate.

allowed_scientific_wording: Reported throughput applies only to the documented benchmark equations.
prohibited_scientific_wording: Generic near-real-time performance guarantees calibrated full-brain performance.
entries.statement: Scalar/local-state benchmark recurrences measure implementation costs, not a calibrated physiological model.

allowed_scientific_wording: The evidence registry is local research infrastructure; upstream data reuse terms require clarification.
prohibited_scientific_wording: All upstream data are cleared for unrestricted commercial redistribution.
entries.statement: Frozen audits record CC-BY Zenodo metadata versus CC-BY-NC FlyWire guidance and unresolved annotation terms; this specification does not resolve that conflict.

allowed_scientific_wording: Any future money/resource mapping must be declared separately.
prohibited_scientific_wording: The fly connectome contains wallet, profit or business-value neurons.
entries.statement: A future financial-runway/resource analogy is a product interpretation, absent from the biological experiments.

E01.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E01.observations: Reported resting-to-spiking separation 21.5 mV and unitary EPSP scale about 1.4 mV. These are distinct from number of simultaneously active PN claws.
E01.preparation_and_measurement: In-vivo whole-cell KC recordings; odors and membrane potentials; sex unresolved in inspected material
E01.transfer_limits: Sparse thresholded integration is supported. No conversion to threshold 0.15, PN gain 3, or arbitrary synthetic PN currents without voltage/rate calibration and matched odor input.

E02.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E02.observations: Multiple coactive claw inputs required for spiking; approximately linear subthreshold summation. Supplementary figures and movies accessible; no numerical trial-level table acquired.
E02.preparation_and_measurement: In-vivo KC claw GCaMP3 imaging and intracellular responses to optogenetically stimulated PNs; female indexed, exact age unresolved
E02.transfer_limits: Supports convergence/nonlinearity, not contact-normalization denominators. PN boutons, claws and EM contact multiplicities are different units.

E03.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E03.observations: Sparse responses depend on concentration, indicator, statistical response criterion and trial reliability.
E03.preparation_and_measurement: Cellular-resolution KC calcium population imaging; odor panel; sex unresolved
E03.transfer_limits: Do not force every synthetic cue to an invariant 5–10% activation target. Need measured PN responses and the same detection operator before fitting sparsity.

E04.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E04.observations: ACh-evoked responses and KC→MBON transmission depend on cholinergic machinery/nicotinic receptors; peptide co-release can enhance responses.
E04.preparation_and_measurement: KC transmitter markers/RNAi; MBON calcium responses to local ACh and KC stimulation; adult preparations, sex unresolved
E04.transfer_limits: Strong class-level cholinergic evidence overrides a contradictory automated KC dopamine prediction. Not a universal contact→conductance scale or proof that all cholinergic targets have identical signs/kinetics.

E05.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E05.observations: Figure 4D: 11 recordings, 9 flies; 1.5 mM ATP, 100 ms pulse, 12.5 psi; five-second fluorescence averages at calyx/lobe. Figure 7 provides spatial measurements and KC inhibition.
E05.preparation_and_measurement: In-vivo local ATP/P2X2 activation, GCaMP6f APL imaging; sex not specified in retrieved methods
E05.transfer_limits: Directly constrains spatial calcium response. Source XLSX acquired, CC-BY. Independent fitted analysis below. Neither calcium attenuation nor the paper's modeled 50 μm space constant is a measured APL→KC gain.

E06.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E06.observations: Local APL feedback regulates odor-evoked microglomerular activity. Public figure source dataset identified.
E06.preparation_and_measurement: Calycal PN/KC/APL functional imaging and anatomical analysis; exact sex/age not extracted here
E06.transfer_limits: Biological normalization is an activity-dependent circuit effect. It does not establish division of every synaptic contact count by total anatomical input. Not fitted here: no observation/odor-to-PN mapping to our arbitrary cues.

E07.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E07.observations: Four 1 ms light pulses at 2 Hz, starting 0.2 s after odor onset; charge-transfer depression **90 ± 3.7% SEM, n=5**. Spikes: 118±8.3→24±7.4, n=7. Backward timing (odor 0.5 s after last light) ineffective; suppression lasts ≥40 min.
E07.preparation_and_measurement: Females collected at eclosion, retinal 36–72 h; in-vivo γ1pedc MBON current/voltage clamp; MB320C PPL1 stimulation, R12G04-LexA target
E07.transfer_limits: Strong quantitative MBON11 plasticity target. Aggregate fit identifies an effective integrated depression, not η, dopamine dose, eligibility τ or floor separately. Does not numerically calibrate α1 appetitive MBON07.

E08.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E08.observations: γ4 KC→MBON EPSCs can potentiate after DAN activation alone; coincident KC/DAN activity can depress transmission. Other compartments differ.
E08.preparation_and_measurement: Brain-explant MBON voltage clamp; KC stimulation and compartmental DAN activation; calcium/state assays; sex unresolved
E08.transfer_limits: Excludes universal “dopamine equals negative synaptic current/LTD” physiology. γ4/γ2 measurements cannot be copied to α1 or γ1pedc by a DAN class name.

E09.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E09.observations: DopR1/DopR2 pathways support different timing-dependent depression/potentiation.
E09.preparation_and_measurement: Adult olfactory conditioning with receptor manipulations and neural/behavioral recording; exact sex/age and raw numerical traces unresolved
E09.transfer_limits: An exponential positive eligibility trace plus LTD-only efficacy is not a complete timing rule. No estimate of the frozen 0.5 s eligibility constant follows from a generic timing dependence.

E10.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E10.observations: NMDA-receptor requirement in PAM-α1; acquisition/consolidation roles in appetitive long-term memory. Direct physiological excitation by MBON-α1 was explicitly left for demonstration.
E10.preparation_and_measurement: Genetic/anatomical and odor–sugar memory assays; PAM-α1 / MBON-α1, MB299B/MB310C; sex unresolved here
E10.transfer_limits: Weakly supports an excitatory feedback hypothesis; **does not experimentally identify the net sign or gain 0.1** on every MBON07→PAM11 root pair. LTM behavior is not a synaptic conductance measurement.

E11.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E11.observations: >50% suppression by second exposure, >80% after 3–7; ISIs 6–60 s; suppression persists at 20 min, recovers by 1 h. Additional odors can accelerate recovery.
E11.preparation_and_measurement: Females 3–5 d, in-vivo MBON-α′3 calcium, MB027B and subgroup drivers; repeated odor, PPL1-α′3 perturbation
E11.transfer_limits: Strong independent response-level target. MBON16/17 grouping is not exact driver membership. Recovery time is not an exponential time constant; nonnegative rates cannot reproduce below-baseline calcium without an observation/baseline model.

E12.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E12.observations: Postsynaptic nicotinic α5/α2 mechanisms contribute to plasticity; α′3 repetition effects need not mirror KC activity loss.
E12.preparation_and_measurement: α′3 female 3–4 d, 3 Hz imaging; 10×1 s OCT with 6 s gaps; receptor fluorescence/FRAP and calcium; M4/6 assays use other preparations
E12.transfer_limits: Supports postsynaptic mechanism candidates, not a unique efficacy multiplier or universal depression rate. [Public repository](https://github.com/owaldlab/2022_postsynapticplasticity) contains connectomic analysis, not an identified matched physiological training/validation table.

E13.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E13.observations: 10 repeated 12 s odor contacts; 24/48 h deprivation. MBON11 trial decline; MBON18 offset-calcium decay differs with state. VPM4 activation suppresses MBON11 responses.
E13.preparation_and_measurement: Adult tethered treadmill, odor and calcium assays; sex not explicit in retrieved methods. MB112C MBON11, MB080C MBON18, MB113C VPM4; MB22B also labels VPM3
E13.transfer_limits: Direction/circuit evidence; no local resource-value→DAN dose curve. Calcium decay and reduced-model integration constants are not membrane τ. Source measurements/code are author-request, not deposited per paper. VPM4 receptor, sign kinetics and specificity need direct measurements.

E14.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E14.observations: Hunger suppresses PPL1-γ1pedc signaling and enhances related MBON expression; DAMB/NPF-related manipulations have specific effects.
E14.preparation_and_measurement: Male flies for food seeking, 24 h deprivation; yeast odors, DAN/MBON manipulations, calcium and receptor perturbations (sex for each imaging cohort not independently resolved here)
E14.transfer_limits: Direction supports a state gate, not a linear function 0.2+0.8r, its 60 s time constant, or an acute divisor 1/(1+D). Male assay to female FAFB transfer needs validation.

E15.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E15.observations: dNPF-mediated state dependence of memory expression; activations/blocks dissociate satiated/hungry expression.
E15.preparation_and_measurement: Adult odor–sugar memory, dNPF/DAN manipulations; exact sex/preparation metadata unresolved here
E15.transfer_limits: Does not identify a peptide wiring graph, receptor concentration at the extracted root, or a quantitative resource transfer function.

E16.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E16.preparation_and_measurement: Antennal-lobe electrophysiology, glutamate iontophoresis and GluClα RNAi; sex unresolved
E16.transfer_limits: Strong sign evidence for tested AL targets; rejects transmitter-name-wide excitatory inference. Does not determine net MBON07→PAM11 sign.

E17.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E17.observations: Nitric oxide co-transmission alters memory dynamics; NOS manipulation affects retention.
E17.preparation_and_measurement: Adult genetic/optogenetic memory and molecular assays; includes PPL1-γ1pedc; exact sex unresolved
E17.transfer_limits: DA-only rule is incomplete. Neither nitric-oxide diffusion/release nor receptor efficacy is in the contact table. No guessed cotransmission added.

E18.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E18.observations: Table 1: five measured τ values 13.54,14.46,24.58,15.50,12.20 ms; mean16.06,SD4.92 ms. −10 pA current steps. Published morphology-fit values and literature synapse kinetics are separately labeled.
E18.preparation_and_measurement: Ex-vivo adult MBON-α3 (**MBON14, not α′3**), 2–3 d, room-temperature patch clamp; physiological sex not explicit (histology male)
E18.transfer_limits: Useful measured temporal scale for MBON14. Not evidence for assigning 16 ms to all MBONs/APL/DANs or replacing a population-rate τ. No α3↔α′3 crosswalk allowed.

E19.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E19.observations: Only a minority (~6%) of KC→MBON synapses have direct DAN synapses at the synaptic site; volume transmission is implicated.
E19.preparation_and_measurement: Adult α-lobe EM and functional assays, separate specimen from FAFB; analysis of release-site arrangement
E19.transfer_limits: Direct DAN contact count is not dopamine exposure or receptor occupancy. The Stage-1 DAN→KC vs Stage-2/3 DAN→MBON operators are competing approximations, not equivalent physiological measurements.

E20.metadata_unknowns: Unresolved sex/age/preparation in the source audit remains unknown.
E20.observations: AKH-related compensation can maintain reinforcement despite hunger-linked DAN inhibition.
E20.preparation_and_measurement: Adult hunger-dependent reinforcement with endocrine manipulation; exact sex/age not extracted
E20.transfer_limits: Motivational suppression and acquisition teaching signals cannot be collapsed into one globally scaled dopamine variable. No quantitative compensation fit attempted.

| [Groschner 2018](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5947940/) | Alpha-beta-core KC in-vivo patch, males 6–24h; imaging males 7d, GCaMP6m; current/voltage/antennal nerve protocols | A-current half-activation −20.3±1.6mV, half-inactivation −72.9±1.2mV; inactivation tau 37.2±2.4ms at +50mV. Reported SEMs. | Voltage-dependent history matters for this subtype/protocol. Constrains an R3 channel component, not whole KC physiology or scalar-vs-compartment count. No complete held-out kinetic dataset acquired. Do not transfer to every KC or 16ms MBON dynamics. |

| [Hafez 2023](https://elifesciences.org/articles/77578), [figures](https://elifesciences.org/articles/77578/figures), [repository](https://doi.org/10.7281/T1/HRK27V) | Ex-vivo MBON14/alpha3, MB082C, 2–3d, room temperature; physiological sex unresolved. Histology male is not sufficient to label patch cohort. −10pA steps | Five original cells mean tau16.056ms. Four-cell supplementary EGFP table inconsistent: raw mean16.9825 vs reported14.48; cell3 duplicates original Vm/tau/C. | Downgraded; no clean held-out validation. Paper's compact dendritic integration is a model-supported result, not a direct measurement of all input locations. Observed two-timescale somatic transients also caution against universal single-exponential voltage dynamics. Repository request returned403; no raw trace fit manufactured. |

| [Stahl 2022](https://elifesciences.org/articles/76712), [data](https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.dfn2z353h) | Adult gamma-lobe ACh sensor, associative conditioning; sex not resolved in inspected text | Compartment-dependent bidirectional release and differential cacophony/Ip3R effects. Linked data API returned inaccessible-identifier message. | Independent reason to distinguish electrical activity from local release/plasticity. A shared electrical state plus local synaptic efficacy could express some findings; not proof every KC needs multiple voltage states. No inaccessible measurements imputed. |
